messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

message.content:
Here’s a list of the public holidays that create long weekends in Canada for 2023 (dates are for the entire country; some holidays are observed only in specific provinces):

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day | January 1 (Sunday) | Observed Monday, Jan 2 |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | February 20 (Monday) | |
| Good Friday | April 7 (Friday) | |
| Easter Monday (Federal employees & some provinces) | April 10 (Monday) | |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | |
| Canada Day | July 1 (Saturday) | Observed Monday, Jul 3 |
| Labour Day | September 4 (Monday) | |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | October 9 (Monday) | |
| Remembrance Day | November 11 (Monday) | |
| Christmas Day | December 25 (Monday) | |
| Boxing Day | December 26 (Tuesday) | |

These holidays typically result in either a 3‑day weekend (if the holiday falls on a Friday or Monday) or a 4‑day weekend (if the holiday falls on a Saturday or Sunday and is observed on the following weekday). If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day in Québec), let me know!
